note: Merge commit bringing origin/main into the branch. Browser figures are read from the run's own fresh-install-playwright-enterprise artifact; wire-level figures are read from the server unit job log of the same run.

deferred.reason: Teams emulator overrides are denied under NODE_ENV=production by design, so the journey needs a development server.
deferred.unaffected: Teams bot adapters, meeting adapters and organizer routing run at the wire level on every candidate.

limitations: Emulator success is not live Microsoft parity; no sandbox credentials exist in this plan's evidence.
Recurring-series and non-UTC timezone delta expansion are unmodelled and answered 400 Request_UnsupportedQuery; that exclusion is asserted by calendar.test.ts rather than assumed.
The callback lane result is recorded separately as microsoft-callback-execution and carries releaseValidation:false.
Wire-level counts are read from a job log rather than a machine-verified verdict artifact.
